## Environment and revision

OS, Python, DCC/renderer/provider versions if applicable, and commit:

## Expected behavior and independent source

Which contract/fixture establishes it?

## Smallest reproduction

Use synthetic or shareable inputs. Do not include secrets, personal paths or private assets.

## Observed behavior

Separate executed results, simulated inputs and inference.

## State and recovery impact

Any lost cancellation, duplicate job/receipt/accounting, stale approval, changed protected asset or unverified process signal?
